description: Read one project ARTIFACT by id: its title, body, author (by), time (at) and project (request_id, project_title). An encrypted project's artifact comes back encrypted:true with no body — the broker holds only ciphertext. MCP twin of GET /artifacts/:artifactId.

artifact_id.description: the artifact id (post_artifact / list_artifacts return it)

name: get_artifact
title: Get project artifact
